meta.name: visual-qa
meta.description: MUST USE after building/changing any UI or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right. Rigorous visual QA across web/page and terminal UIs. Prefer browser:control-in-app-browser for unauthenticated browser/page QA in Codex, then Playwright/agent-browser/dev-browser. Captures screenshot/TUI evidence with bundled diff scripts, runs design-system/functional and visual-fidelity/CJK reviewer passes, then synthesizes a good/bad verdict. Triggers: visual QA, screenshot/pixel diff, UI looks wrong, reference fidelity, design system check, responsive check, CJK text clipping, TUI alignment, box-drawing drift.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动检查UI页面和终端界面的视觉正确性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要自动化验证UI的像素级正确性
copy.tagline_en: Automatically verify visual correctness of UI pages and terminal interfaces
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need automated pixel-level UI verification

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会在你构建或修改任何用户界面后，自动进行严格的视觉质量检查。它会截取屏幕截图，与参考图对比，并检查设计系统、功能正确性和文字显示问题，最终给出“通过”或“不通过”的结论。
howto.when: 当你构建或修改了网页界面或终端界面，并准备宣布完成时触发。也适用于怀疑界面出现回归问题、文字显示异常或布局错位时。

say.text: 帮我检查这个新做的登录页面，看看和设计稿是否一致。
say.note: Claude 会截取页面截图并与参考图对比，给出差异报告。

say.text: 检查一下这个终端界面的布局，有没有边框错位或文字溢出。
say.note: Claude 会捕获终端渲染结果并检查对齐和溢出问题。

say.text: 这个页面的中文文字好像被截断了，帮我检查一下。
say.note: Claude 会专门检查 CJK 文字是否显示完整。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude automatically performs rigorous visual QA when you build or modify any UI. It captures screenshots, compares them with references, and checks design system integrity, functionality, and CJK text issues, then gives a pass/fail verdict.
howto.when_en: Triggered after building or changing any web/page or terminal UI, before declaring it done. Also when suspecting regressions, text clipping, or layout misalignment.

say_en.text: Check this new login page against the design mockup.
say_en.note: Claude will capture screenshots and compare them, reporting differences.

say_en.text: Check this terminal UI layout for border misalignment or text overflow.
say_en.note: Claude will capture the terminal render and check alignment and overflow.

say_en.text: The Chinese text on this page seems clipped, please check.
say_en.note: Claude will specifically check CJK text rendering.
